subject: "Page not found" error after upgrading shiny-server

messages.author: 65b36fc7ed4b5fa2
messages.subject: "Page not found" error after upgrading shiny-server
parts:
I am running a server with Redhat6

Yesterday, I upgraded from:
Shiny Server v1.2.3.368 (Node.js v0.10.21)

to:
Shiny Server (Commercial) v1.2.3.456 (Node.js v0.10.21)

Before the upgrade, everything was fully functional.

Now, all the shiny pages display the following error message:
"Page not found

Sorry, but the page you requested doesn't exist."

This includes the sample app generated by running:
"sudo /opt/shiny-server/bin/deploy-example default"

The only suspicious thing I can see in the "shiny-server.log" file is that:
"Shiny Server opportunistically dropped root privileges when it last started up. If you've changed the configuration in such a way that it now requires root privileges to run correctly, you'll need to restart Shiny Server to perform those privileged operations (like bind to a port < 1024, run user_apps, or have multiple 'run_as' directives."

So, I modified the config file to "run_as root" in case this was related to a permissions issue. 

Any ideas about what might have caused this issue?

Thanks!

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: "Page not found" error after upgrading shiny-server
parts:
Winn,

First, you cannot use "run_as root"; you should change this back to a non-root user.

Please include:
- your shiny-server.conf file
- URL that you access for your application
- Contents of your application directory (listing of files/directories)

Fereshteh

messages.subject: Re: "Page not found" error after upgrading shiny-server
parts:
Thank you for your assistance. I resolved the issue by changing the lines in the apache server configuration file from:

ProxyPass /shiny http://localhost:3838/shiny timeout=1200

to:

ProxyPass /shiny http://localhost:3838 timeout=1200
